EDGE-pos1.label: violation
EDGE-pos1.note: An application ports barrel re-exports the press house's error class next to the ports, and the use case imports it from the barrel.

EDGE-pos2.label: violation
EDGE-pos2.note: The use case pulls the press house's SDK in with import = require() to check for its error class.

EDGE-pos3.label: violation
EDGE-pos3.note: A domain module publishes the press house's SDK with export *, and the harvest lot takes the run report type from it.

EDGE-twin1.label: clean
EDGE-twin1.note: The report use case loads a domain yield module with a dynamic import(); application may depend on domain.

EDGE-twin2.label: clean
EDGE-twin2.note: The pressing gateway uses import = require() for the press house's SDK; an outbound adapter may depend on the vendor.

EDGE-twin3.label: clean
EDGE-twin3.note: The report use case types a local with an inline import() type of the domain harvest lot; application may depend on domain.

EDGE-twin4.label: clean
EDGE-twin4.note: A domain index publishes the domain modules with export *, and the application imports from it; all within allowed layers.

KEY-pos1.label: violation
KEY-pos1.note: The webhook passes the raw run state; the use case looks it up in a Map keyed by the press house's run-state words.

KEY-pos2.label: violation
KEY-pos2.note: The pressing port carries the press house's raw grade; a domain switch over the grade words sets the grower payout rate.

KEY-twin1.label: clean
KEY-twin1.note: Same run-state Map as KEY-pos1, but it sits in the webhook adapter, which hands the core its own pressing progress.

KEY-twin2.label: clean
KEY-twin2.note: Same grade switch and raw grade as KEY-pos2, but the spec glossary declares PRIME, JUICING and CULL as the cooperative's own payment grades.

SET-pos1.label: violation
SET-pos1.note: The webhook hands the raw run state to the core; the domain copies the press house's six run states as an enum and the use case casts the port's text to it.

SET-pos2.label: violation
SET-pos2.note: The pressing port carries the press house's raw grade; the domain copies its three grades as a union and the use case casts the port's text to it.

SET-twin1.label: clean
SET-twin1.note: The core adds its own lot use set (table, press, compost), mapped from the press house's three grades in the gateway.

SET-twin2.label: clean
SET-twin2.note: Intake staff record their own fruit check (PRIME, BRUISED, WORMY, FROSTED) through the HTTP adapter; it shares one of the press house's three grade words by coincidence.

WORD-pos1.label: violation
WORD-pos1.note: The harvest lot renames its residue field to pomace, the press house's own field name, while the glossary owns residue.

WORD-pos2.label: violation
WORD-pos2.note: The core lot status gains SETTLING, a value word of the press house's run states, for juice that is standing after pressing.

WORD-twin1.label: clean
WORD-twin1.note: The harvest lot gains brix, the cooperative's own sugar reading at intake that grower payment rests on, declared in the spec glossary; the press house also has a field brix.

WORD-twin2.label: clean
WORD-twin2.note: The harvest lot gains weight, the gross weight on the cooperative's scale; weight is a generic word that the press house also uses.
